name: Pygmalion
source:
Andrew is a successful manga artist that, in a fit of disapointment over his work, creates a character just like the woman of his dreams. But characters can't come to life, can they? 

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=1648]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
安德鲁是一名成功的漫画家。一次对作品深感失望时，他创造了一个与梦中情人完全相同的角色。可是，虚构角色不可能活过来……对吧？

[译自 [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=1648]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
